coupled_controller.upstream_state: actual wrist and swing; commanded MCP
coupled_controller.distal_axis: DIP pivot to URDF-chain distal support landmark; TODO(V32-07)
coupled_controller.reference_validation: all eight origin-pose target angles must satisfy requested bounds

solver.name: bounded_pip_grid_analytic_dip_interval_v1
solver.preference: minimum squared PIP/DIP displacement from origin among feasible candidates
solver.error: distance outside each finger interval; zero throughout interval

coupled_controller.update: re-solved before every physical substep; no qpos projection
coupled_controller.angle: signed downward angle of directed distal axis to resting piano plane

limitations: Bounded local least-squares with exact current coupling at scratch poses. No dynamics, collision clearance or global infeasibility certification.
